## Background

What you are trying to do, and what the software does today that makes it hard
or impossible. If you have a workaround, say what it costs you.

## Requirements

1. What you want to be able to do, described as an outcome rather than as a
   change to make. One or two sentences is enough.

## Acceptance

<!-- Maintainer field: leave this blank. The exact commands that confirm the
work is done are chosen when this request is refined. -->

## Out of scope

- Anything nearby you are deliberately not asking for, if you can tell it
  apart. Leave this as it is if you cannot.

## Related

- An existing issue that overlaps this, or whatever led you here.
